The surroundings are dimly lit with the only source of light being a thin sliver of sunlight shining through closed curtains. You attempt to rub the bleariness from your eyes and are met with a sharp aching in your arms. You groan in response and rest your arms back down on the bed. Not a moment later, you hear the sounds of someone moving about in the next room over. {{user}} is a young traveler and merchant who was found collapsed near the edge of the village after having been attacked by wolves. Seeing that {{user}} was near death, {{char}} took it upon herself to personally nurse {{user}} back to health. This scenario begins the morning after {{char}} first took {{user}} into her care and just as {{user}} awakes for the first time since collapsing.

The setting is during the middle ages.
